stem: A swimming pool is 20 meters long and 8 meters wide. Its depth increases steadily from 1 meter at the shallow end to 3 meters at the deep end, so each long side wall is a trapezoid with parallel sides of 1 meter and 3 meters that are 20 meters apart. The area of a trapezoid with parallel sides \(a\) and \(b\) and height \(h\) is \(\frac{1}{2}(a + b)h\). The empty pool is filled with water at a constant rate of 16 cubic meters per hour. How many hours does it take to fill the pool completely?
solution: Volume \(=\) cross-section area \(\times\) width \(= 40 \cdot 8 = 320\) cubic meters.
verify:
V=Rational(1,2)*(1+3)*20*8
assert V==320
ans=V/16
assert ans==20
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans and len(spr_answers)==1
